description: TikTok: hide a comment on the account's own video from everyone but the person who wrote it, or show it again (hidden: false). Pass reply_id from comment_replies_list, or account_id with a comment_id from comments_recent. The comment's answer here, if any, leaves Today and Inbox; showing it again brings that back.

account_id.description: ID of the account the comment is on (a UUID): from accounts_list; use with comment_id

comment_id.description: The network's own comment ID, as comments_recent gives it

hidden.description: false shows a hidden comment again

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

reply_id.description: ID of the answer record (a UUID) when the comment came from comments_to_answer

name: comment_hide
title: Hide a comment
